bio: Hey, I'm Alex. For 8 years I've helped startups turn rough ideas into products people actually want to use. I obsess over the details so founders can focus on building the business.

projects.title: SmartSolve
projects.desc1: End-to-end product design for an early-stage startup, from initial discovery workshops and user research through to a complete, developer-ready design system. The challenge was creating a scalable interface architecture that could grow alongside the product.
projects.desc2: The result: a clean, modular UI built in Figma with a full component library, interactive prototype, and handoff documentation. The product launched in Q3 with a 40% improvement in task completion rate measured in usability testing.

blocks.caption: The mobile app got 100k+ download in the first month after the redesign.

projects.title: Kodai
projects.desc1: A full mobile experience redesign for a software with over 200k users. The brief was to modernize the visual language while reducing friction in the core user flows: onboarding, navigation, and content discovery.
projects.desc2: Through extensive user interviews and A/B testing, we simplified the navigation from 6 tabs to 3, introduced a new gesture-based interaction model, and built a motion design system to bring the app to life with purposeful micro-animations.

projects.title: Raena AI
projects.desc1: A brand identity and creative strategy project for a B2B SaaS company entering a new market. Starting from a brand audit and competitive analysis, we defined a new visual language, messaging framework, and design direction to resonate with enterprise buyers.
projects.desc2: Deliverables included a full brand identity system: logo, typography, color palette, illustration style alongside a digital brand guide, marketing site redesign, and a suite of campaign assets.

projects.title: Vallum
projects.desc1: Designing the interface layer for an AI-powered analytics platform: a complex dashboard that surfaces real-time data, model outputs, and user controls in a way that feels approachable, not overwhelming.
projects.desc2: Deep collaboration with engineers and data scientists to translate complexity into a UI that non-technical users could act on confidently. Shipped with a 92% satisfaction score in post-launch surveys.
